Energy Dashboard能源宏观仪表盘

Global energy markets for macro: crude and products, gas and LNG, European power, supply, demand, inventories, positioning and the pass-through to inflation. Sources: EIA, IMF (via FRED), CFTC, energy-charts (SMARD), CBOE and the US Treasury.面向宏观的全球能源市场：原油与成品油、天然气与LNG、欧洲电力、供给、需求、库存、持仓以及向通胀的传导。数据来源：EIA、IMF（经FRED）、CFTC、energy-charts（SMARD）、CBOE与美国财政部。

Data policy: no fabricated proxies. Official public sources provide the primary foundation for Energy; native statistical and central bank releases are prioritized where available. 数据原则：不制造 proxy。官方公开来源提供能源的基础数据；优先接入本国统计局与央行的原生发布序列。
